title: IVF: ovarian stimulation and injections
what: You give yourself hormone injections so that several eggs mature in the ovaries. The doctor watches this with ultrasounds and blood tests.
why: This is the first stage of IVF. It starts on your doctor's schedule, usually at the beginning of the cycle.
duration: injections usually last 8 to 14 days, with several ultrasounds
tell_doctor: All your medicines. Do not stop them on your own
If you are afraid to inject yourself. You will get help

prepare.title: Schedule
prepare.text: Get a written schedule from your doctor: which medicine, what dose, and what time.

prepare.title: Storage
prepare.text: Some medicines are kept in the fridge. Check the instructions.

prepare.title: Training
prepare.text: Ask the nurse to show you how to give the injection.

prepare.title: Calendar
prepare.text: Set phone reminders for your injection times.

bring: Your medicines, if asked to bring them
steps: Wash your hands and get the pen or syringe ready
Wipe the skin on your belly with an alcohol wipe
Put in the needle and slowly inject the medicine
Hold the needle for a few seconds, then take it out
Write down the time and dose
Come for ultrasounds and blood tests on the set days
feel: A quick prick, sometimes a small bruise
Bloating and heaviness low in the belly
after: When the follicles are mature, you get a trigger shot. Give it at exactly the set time
At a set time after it, the eggs are collected
red_flags: Severe belly pain or bloating: call your doctor or emergency services
Shortness of breath, little urine, or sudden weight gain: call emergency services

faq.q: What if I missed an injection?
faq.a: Call your doctor or clinic right away. Do not double the dose on your own.
Usually yes. The main thing is not to miss injections and ultrasounds.

reminders.text: Time for your IVF injection. Check the medicine and dose, and write down the time.
